newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan March domestic vehicle output up 13.4% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan March domestic vehicle output up 13.4% yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's vehicle production in March rose 13.4 percent from a year earlier to 1,092,102 units, the Japan Automobile Manufacturers' Association said on Friday.
Output rose in March after falling in February for the first time in six months.
The association also said vehicle production for the year which ended on March 31 rose 5.2 percent from a year earlier to 10,612,045 units. It was the first yearly production gain in six years.
The gains in March and in 1996/97 were helped by a recovery in exports and strong domestic demand ahead of an increase in Japan's sales tax on April 1, an association spokeswoman said.
The association said it expected exports in 1996/97 to have risen about six percent from a year earlier and exports in March to have risen nine percent.
The association will announce official export figures on April 28.
